items.title: xAI dev leaks API key for private SpaceX, Tesla LLMs
items.raw_content: An employee at Elon Musk’s artificial intelligence company xAI leaked a private key on GitHub that for the past two months could have allowed anyone to query private xAI large language models (LLMs) which appear to have been custom made for working with internal data from Musk’s companies, including SpaceX , Tesla and Twitter/X, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. Philippe Caturegli , “chief hacking officer” at the security consultancy Seralys , was the first to publicize the leak of credentials for an x.ai application programming interface (API) exposed in the GitHub code repository of a technical staff member at xAI.
items.title_zh: xAI 开发者泄露 SpaceX、Tesla 私有 LLM 的 API 密钥
items.summary: An xAI employee exposed a private API key in a GitHub repository, and for about two months it could have let outsiders query internal xAI models apparently built for SpaceX, Tesla and X data, KrebsOnSecurity reports.

items.title: Qwen3: Think deeper, act faster
items.raw_content: QWEN CHAT GitHub Hugging Face ModelScope Kaggle DEMO DISCORD Introduction Today, we are excited to announce the release of Qwen3, the latest addition to the Qwen family of large language models. Our flagship model, Qwen3-235B-A22B, achieves competitive results in benchmark evaluations of coding, math, general capabilities, etc., when compared to other top-tier models such as DeepSeek-R1, o1, o3-mini, Grok-3, and Gemini-2.5-Pro. Additionally, the small MoE model, Qwen3-30B-A3B, outcompetes QwQ-32B with 10 times of activated parameters, and even a tiny model like Qwen3-4B can rival the performance of Qwen2.
items.title_zh: Qwen3：思考更深，行动更快
items.summary: The Qwen team released Qwen3, led by the Qwen3-235B-A22B flagship, which it says is competitive with DeepSeek-R1, o1, o3-mini, Grok-3 and Gemini-2.5-Pro on coding, math and general benchmarks. The smaller Qwen3-30B-A3B MoE model is said to outperform QwQ-32B, while Qwen3-4B is claimed to rival Qwen2.

items.summary: Researchers apply the Responsible AI Labs (RAIL) framework and its eight measurable dimensions to Anthropic's Values in the Wild dataset of over 308,000 anonymized Claude conversations to assess LLM ethical behavior in real-world use.

items.title: Deep Generative Prior for First Order Inverse Optimization
items.title_zh: 面向一阶逆向优化的深度生成先验
items.summary: The paper introduces Deep Physics Prior, a method that enables first-order gradient-based inverse optimization with surrogate machine-learning models by using pretrained neural operators to enforce prior distribution constraints. It targets settings such as semiconductor manufacturing and fluid dynamics where explicit mathematical representations are lacking.

items.title: Graph Synthetic Out-of-Distribution Exposure with Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 借助大语言模型实现图上的合成分布外暴露
items.summary: GOE-LLM uses zero-shot LLM annotations and LLM-generated synthetic nodes to expose graph classifiers to out-of-distribution samples without any real OOD nodes, reporting up to a 23.5% AUROC improvement.

items.title: Balancing Security and Liquidity: A Time-Weighted Snapshot Framework for DAO Governance Voting
items.title_zh: 平衡安全与流动性：DAO 治理投票的时间加权快照框架
items.summary: The paper examines flash-loan attacks that exploit token-weighted DAO governance voting and proposes a time-weighted snapshot framework intended to improve security while weighing liquidity trade-offs.

items.title: GenSync: A Generalized Talking Head Framework for Audio-driven Multi-Subject Lip-Sync using 3D Gaussian Splatting
items.title_zh: GenSync：基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 的音频驱动多主体唇形同步通用说话头框架
items.summary: GenSync is a framework for audio-driven lip-synced video synthesis across multiple subjects using 3D Gaussian Splatting; its disentanglement module separates identity features from audio and enables 6.8x faster training than state-of-the-art models, according to the authors.

items.title: Universal Approximation Theorem of Deep Q-Networks
items.title_zh: 深度 Q 网络的万能逼近定理
items.summary: The paper develops a continuous-time framework based on stochastic control and forward-backward stochastic differential equations to analyze Deep Q-Networks. It shows that DQNs can approximate the optimal Q-function on compact sets with arbitrary accuracy and high probability, and analyzes Q-learning convergence.

items.title: Position: Foundation Models Need Digital Twin Representations
items.title_zh: 立场：基础模型需要数字孪生表征
items.summary: This position paper argues that token representations limit foundation models' semantic coherence, spatial-temporal modeling and causal reasoning, and proposes digital twin representations that encode domain knowledge and preserve continuous real-world processes.
